name: Flyers Creek Wind Farm
current_developer: Flyers Creek Wind Farm Pty Ltd
notable: 38x GE 3.8-137 turbines. Iberdrola Australia developed. Located near Orange, NSW.

timeline.title: NSW development approval
timeline.detail: Original planning approval granted but project shelved

timeline.title: Construction commenced
timeline.detail: Iberdrola revived project; 38 GE 3.8 MW turbines; 230 construction jobs

timeline.title: Commercial operations commenced
timeline.detail: Commencement date from AEMO registration via OpenElectricity.

timeline.title: First generation recorded
timeline.detail: First market dispatch data recorded in AEMO systems.

eis_specs.document_title: Flyers Creek Wind Farm — other source (v3.31.0 wind tranche 2)
eis_specs.connection_substation_name: Orange North to Cadia 132 kV line (new on-site switching station)
eis_specs.notes: Regime: other. Original Project Approval by NSW Planning Assessment Commission 2014 under Part 3A/SSD transition (originally 42 x 3 MW). Multiple modifications approved to increase tip height to 160 m/rotor to 140 m. Iberdrola Australia developer. Located 15 km west of Blayney (Blayney Shire LGA); commissioned 2024.

timeline_events.title: NSW planning approval (2014)
timeline_events.detail: Flyers Creek received NSW state planning consent in 2014 — long before the LTESA award.

timeline_events.title: NSW LTESA Round 4 underwriting awarded (145 MW)
timeline_events.detail: Flyers Creek wins NSW LTESA Round 4 underwriting — 145 MW. Owned by Iberdrola Australia. One of 2 R4 winners (alongside Maryvale Solar + BESS). Round only awarded 33% of its 1,150 MW target.
